reasons.persona_fit: Accurately targets the 1-10 person business owner, maintains Bareni's calm technical voice, complies with the no-CTA rule, and reframes an abstract topic into an operational decision.
reasons.clarity: Logical structure, direct explanations, and an immediately clear message on why data centralization precedes automation.
reasons.actionability: Gives a concrete, realistic diagnostic exercise for small business owners to audit where data lives before considering automation tools.
reasons.factual_grounding: Makes no unsupported claims, invents no customers or metrics, and accurately reflects Bareni's standard tooling and operating boundaries.
